subject: MSA review: pen-test notice, SOC2 evidence swimlanes, and legal queue
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@bluenova.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-22 09:12 PST
Subject: Security exhibit clarifications — pen test notice and evidence cadence

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for sending the MSA/Order Form last week. A couple of questions came up in security as we loop through the exhibit:

- Pen test notice: our policy requires 30-day notice for coordinated tests. The Redlines I saw reference "reasonable notice" — can you confirm a fixed window?
- SOC 2 evidence: we want a steady cadence for sample evidence (quarterly snapshots + annual artifacts). Can you outline an evidence handoff swimlane so our InfoSec ops can plan?
- Staging access: for the pen test we need ephemeral staging creds that expire automatically; is that supported and documented?

I attached a short scope doc that includes our desired notice and sample list. Would appreciate a quick call to align so we can keep procurement moving.

Marta Lopez
Sr. Security Program Manager, BlueNova Therapeutics
Attachments: BLU-request-pen-test-scope.pdf
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@bluenova.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-22 10:03 PST
Subject: Re: Security exhibit clarifications — pen test notice and evidence cadence

Marta — thanks for the clear notes and the scope doc. Quick answers up front, then next steps below.

- Pen test notice: we can accept a 30-day coordinated notice for scheduled, non-emergent tests. For emergency vuln findings (critical), we reserve the right to negotiate timing; we'll add explicit language to the exhibit: "scheduled tests: 30 calendar days notice; emergency tests: mutually agreed urgency pathway."
- Evidence swimlane: we have a templated swimlane we use for enterprise customers (quarterly snapshots, monthly sampling for high-risk subsystems). Laura — I copied you for legal language and to confirm any SOC 2 evidence limits in the MSA.
- Staging creds: Redwood supports time-limited staging tokens and ephemeral SSH jump hosts for pen tests. I'll attach the ops stub and evidence matrix.

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura to review exhibit redlines and confirm wording for the 30-day notice and emergency carveouts.
2) Ben to confirm procurement timeline and if they require an exception for on-call emergency tests.
3) Schedule a 30-min bridge (tomorrow) with BlueNova security to walk the swimlane and capture any changes.

Attachments: evidence-swimlane-2028-05.xlsx, BLU-pen-test-scope-draft.pdf

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@bluenova.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-23 08:26 PST
Subject: Re: Security exhibit clarifications — pen test notice and evidence cadence

Hi all — reviewing the proposed language. I made track-changes on the MSA exhibit; high-level items below and attached the redline doc.

- Notice window: Accept 30-day for scheduled tests. Proposed exhibit text: "For scheduled penetration testing, Customer will provide Redwood with no fewer than thirty (30) calendar days' prior written notice. For emergency or threat-driven testing, parties will use the Emergency Testing Protocol (Exhibit B) to coordinate timing and scope."
- Emergency Protocol: we will not allow unscheduled mass scans without prior coordination; we will permit time-boxed, scoped emergency testing if run through the protocol.
- Evidence cadence & retention: limit evidence pull requests to one quarterly snapshot plus two ad-hoc samples per quarter for production tenants unless otherwise agreed in writing. For audit purposes, we can provide SOC 2 attestation documents and a rolling 90-day access to audit logs; longer retention packages are available as add-ons.
- Staging access ops: added a short ops paragraph requiring ephemeral credentials tied to a named test and expiration timestamp; requests go through the Customer Ops ticketing link and require at least one RW engineer on call for window.

Attachments: msa-redlines-track-changes.docx

Laura Bennett
Counsel, Contracts & Security, Redwood Inference
